title: Published research sustained visible reach over the preceding year

next_validation: Prioritise the sector where access, technical fit and a measurable decision problem align.

title: The Harmonic Nexus turns specialist work into an accessible research narrative
summary: Public essays add an editorial layer around formal records, helping technical and non-technical audiences follow the development of the ideas.
